one_liner: Nifty 50 declines by 0.50% amid increased volatility and mixed institutional flows.

drivers.title: No Catalyst Found
drivers.detail: No identifiable catalyst for today's market movements.

drivers.title: IT Sector Slump
drivers.detail: Nifty IT fell by 2.28%, leading sectoral declines.

drivers.title: Pharma Gains
drivers.detail: Nifty Pharma rose by 0.75%, bucking the trend.

drivers.title: Volatility Spike
drivers.detail: India VIX increased by 4.49%, indicating higher volatility.

flows_line: FIIs net bought Rs 280.13 Cr; DIIs net bought Rs 566.76 Cr.
watch_next: Tomorrow, watch for Nifty 50 weekly options expiry and GIFT Nifty cues.
lesson_seeds: Market declines can occur without clear catalysts.
IT sector can significantly impact overall market sentiment.
Volatility spikes often accompany market downturns.
Pharma sector can perform well even in broader market declines.
